name: PostHog
description: PostHog lets agents query events and funnels, inspect feature flags, and summarize what changed after a release. A personal API key from the project settings goes into one Authorization header.

prompts.text: How does the signup funnel look for the last 14 days?
Which feature flags are enabled for this user?
Did activation change after last week's release?

apps.name: PostHog
apps.description: Event, funnel, and feature-flag access, over PostHog's MCP server with a personal API key.
